paragraphs: Hello, I am Leo, and I draw cartoons for Explorers' Blog. My school is big, and it has many rooms. Today I take you on a sign tour of my school. A sign is a short text, and you must read it fast. That is not easy for a boy who likes cartoons! Please come with me.

The first two signs are at the school nurse's room. The sign on the door says, "NURSE'S ROOM. PLEASE KNOCK AND WAIT." Nurse Jill works in this room. She is kind, and she helps children who are not well. The sign on the shelf says, "MEDICINE: ONLY NURSE JILL GIVES MEDICINE." That is a good idea, because medicine is not a toy.

The next two signs are in the science room. The room has long tables and many small machines. The first sign says, "USE THE BLUE BIN FOR PAPER." The second sign is a big card on the wall. It says, "INVENT DAY. BUILD A NEW MACHINE FROM PAPER. FRIDAY, ONE O'CLOCK." I want to invent a machine that draws my cartoons. My friends think I am lazy, but I also have good ideas.

Then we go to the gym and the bicycle park. In the gym, Coach Matt has a silver whistle. He uses it when the game is very noisy. The sign near the door says, "ONE LONG WHISTLE MEANS STOP." The last sign is in the bicycle park. It says, "CYCLE PARK. PLEASE LOCK YOUR BICYCLE." Many students cycle to school, so this sign is important.

Now you know six signs in my school. It is a nice school, and I like its signs. Before you wash your hands and go home, please answer a question. Have you ever read a sign that made you laugh? Write to us, and tell us about it. Leo
text.summary: Leo writes a blog post about six signs in his school. He tells what each sign says about the nurse's room, the science room, the gym, and the cycle park, and he asks the readers a question.
